prompt: 写实夜生活摄影，9:16 竖幅，豪华商务 KTV 私人包厢，深色皮质沙发，黑金大理石桌面，暖金灯带混合蓝紫霓虹，手机直闪抓拍质感，轻微颗粒，真实皮肤纹理，轻微过曝，高 ISO 夜间摄影，28mm 近距离镜头，私人相册感，随机抓拍，不看起来像棚拍。 画面主体为 20 多岁成年东亚女性，精致自然妆，深色长发，穿精致夜店连衣裙，身材自然，表情放松微醺。包厢内同时存在来消费的成年男性客人，约 30 到 45 岁，普通办公室体型到微胖，商务休闲或衬衫穿搭，作为陪衬人物，不抢主体。 桌上有威士忌、玻璃杯、冰桶、水果盘、零食、麦克风、纸巾和杂乱酒局用品。背景有 KTV 屏幕、沙发和其他朋友，真实中国高端商务 KTV 夜生活氛围。人物脸型全部不同，避免复制脸，避免所有人同年龄同体型。

promptTranslations.en: Realistic nightlife photography, 9:16 vertical ratio, luxury business KTV private room, dark leather sofa, black-and-gold marble tabletop, warm gold LED strip lighting mixed with blue-purple neon, phone direct-flash candid snapshot texture, slight grain, realistic skin texture, slight overexposure, high ISO night photography, 28mm close-range lens, private photo album feel, spontaneous candid shot, does not look like a studio shoot. The main subject is an adult East Asian woman in her 20s, with delicate natural makeup, long dark hair, wearing an exquisite club dress, natural body shape, with a relaxed, slightly tipsy expression. In the private room, there are also adult male paying guests, around 30 to 45 years old, average office build to slightly chubby, dressed in business casual or button-up shirts, acting as secondary background figures without overshadowing the main subject. On the table are whiskey, glass tumblers, an ice bucket, a fruit platter, snacks, microphones, tissues, and messy party drinking supplies. In the background are the KTV screen, sofas, and other friends, capturing an authentic Chinese high-end business KTV nightlife atmosphere. All characters have distinct face shapes, avoiding cloned faces, and avoiding having everyone of the same age and body type.
